rules.name: Bladder_UrineSymptoms
rules.description: Matches symptoms directly related to the urinary system, such as blood in urine or painful urination.

rules.name: Bladder_OccupationalChemicalRisk
rules.description: Identifies specific occupations associated with chemical exposure as a risk factor for bladder cancer.

rules.name: Bladder_ChronicIrritationCause
rules.description: Matches the specific cause 'chronic irritation' in the context of being a cause for cancer, now with higher priority to win against generic risk factors.

rules.name: Bladder_SlowGrowingTreatment
rules.description: Detects descriptive phrases about the cancer being slow-growing and responsive to treatment.

rules.name: BreastCancerKeyword
rules.description: Matches the explicit phrase 'breast cancer' and variations like 'ofBreast cancer' to be robust to missing spaces between words or common concatenations found in training data.

rules.name: BreastAnatomyKeyword
rules.description: Matches the words 'breast' or 'breasts', which are central to the diagnosis and discussion of this cancer type.

rules.name: NippleAnatomyKeyword
rules.description: Matches the word 'nipple', a highly specific anatomical part directly associated with breast cancer symptoms.

rules.name: LumpMenstrualContext
rules.description: Matches 'lump' in close proximity to 'woman's menstrual cycle', now with an increased character window for better contextual matching.

rules.name: Cervical_DirectMention
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of 'cervical cancer' or its common abbreviation 'CC'.

rules.name: Cervical_SpecificBleeding
rules.description: Identifies specific bleeding patterns related to cervical cancer, now explicitly matching parenthetical descriptions.

rules.name: Cervical_VaginalDiscomfortDischarge
rules.description: Detects mentions of vaginal discomfort or specific types of odorous vaginal discharge, potentially containing blood.

rules.name: Cervical_GeneralConstitutionalSymptoms
rules.description: Captures general constitutional symptoms (fatigue, weight loss, loss of appetite) explicitly provided as a positive example for cervical cancer.

rules.name: Colorectal_BowelSymptoms
rules.description: Matches common symptoms like diarrhea, changes in bowel habits, or abdominal pain specific to colorectal cancer.

rules.name: Colorectal_SpecificDiet
rules.description: Identifies the specific dietary link involving 'high fat and low fiber diet'.

rules.name: Colorectal_SocioEconomicFactor
rules.description: Catches descriptions related to its prevalence in richer demographics or being a 'rich man's disease'.

rules.name: EsophagealCausesRiskFactors
rules.description: Matches common causes and risk factors for esophageal cancer. Its priority has been lowered to prevent it from broadly overriding more specific cancer classifications.

rules.name: EsophagealSpecificSymptoms
rules.description: Identifies specific symptoms related to esophageal cancer, focusing on difficulty swallowing, choking, and throat pain/spasms.
rules.content: (?i)\b(?:trouble in swallowing|choking|pain in the throat|spasms in the throat)\b

rules.name: EsophagealPreventionRetardants
rules.description: Matches mentions of specific vitamins recommended as retardants for esophageal cancer.

rules.name: eyes_eyed_persons
rules.description: Matches phrases indicating risk for 'eyed persons', which is highly specific to eye-related context.

rules.name: eyes_uv_rays
rules.description: Matches 'U/V rays' or 'UV rays', which are known environmental factors for eye conditions.

rules.name: eyes_melanoma_keyword
rules.description: Matches the keyword 'melanoma', which appears in a positive example for eye cancer and does not conflict with provided counter-examples.

rules.name: Kidney_RenalCancerTerms
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of 'Renal Cell Cancer' or 'Renal pelvic cancers', which are specific names for kidney cancer.

rules.name: Kidney_CombinedSymptoms
rules.description: Matches the specific combination of 'blood in the urine' with related symptoms like 'backache' or 'upper abdomen', distinguishing it from other cancers with 'blood in urine' (e.g., bladder).
rules.content: (?i)\bblood in the urine\b(?:,?.*?(?:\bbackache\b|\bupper abdomen\b|\blumps in the upper abdomen\b))

rules.name: Kidney_SpecificRiskFactorsOccupations
rules.description: Matches specific chemical risk factors or occupations uniquely associated with kidney cancer. Priority increased to ensure it wins against generic risk factors.

rules.name: Kidney_DemographicComparison
rules.description: Matches the specific demographic comparison indicating that kidney cancer affects 'most men than women'.

rules.name: Kidney_AgeDemographic
rules.description: Matches the specific age demographic 'over age of 60 years' or 'age of 60 years' mentioned in relation to kidney cancer.

rules.name: Laryngeal_Symptoms_ThroatVoice
rules.description: Matches text describing symptoms specifically related to the throat or voice, such as hoarseness or discomfort in the throat, which are indicative of laryngeal cancer.

rules.name: Laryngeal_Causes_SpecificChemicals
rules.description: Matches text that identifies a specific combination of environmental and lifestyle factors (tobacco, alcohol, asbestos, and nickel) as suspected causes. Priority increased for this highly specific combination.

rules.name: liver_direct_mention
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of 'liver' or 'cirrhosis', which is strongly linked to liver cancer.

rules.name: liver_jaundice_symptom
rules.description: Identifies the symptom 'jaundice', a characteristic sign of liver disease.

rules.name: liver_specific_risk_factors
rules.description: Detects specific risk factors for liver cancer such as aflatoxins or vinyl chloride. Priority increased to ensure it wins against generic risk factors.

rules.name: liver_abdominal_swelling_symptom
rules.description: Matches the symptom 'abdominal swelling', which can be indicative of liver problems.

rules.name: LungCancerDirectMention
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of 'lung cancer', providing the most precise classification.

rules.name: LungCancerSmokingRelated
rules.description: Identifies text related to smoking or smokers, which are primary causes strongly associated with lung cancer.

rules.name: LungCancerPersistentCough
rules.description: Detects specific symptoms like 'persistent cough' or 'coughing', which are characteristic of lung cancer.

rules.name: LungCancerPollutionFactors
rules.description: Matches terms related to environmental factors like 'pollution' or 'toxicity', which are linked to increased chances of lung cancer.

rules.name: OralCancerExplicit
rules.description: Matches explicit mentions of 'oral cancer'.

rules.name: OralCavitySpecificSymptoms
rules.description: Identifies highly specific symptoms or conditions directly within the oral cavity (mouth, tongue, jaw) including leukoplakia, dysphagia, mouth ulcers, patches, swelling, and pain.

rules.name: OralFunctionAndTasteSymptoms
rules.description: Matches symptoms related to difficulty with oral functions like chewing, swallowing, speaking, or changes in taste and tolerating spicy foods.

rules.name: NeckAndLymphNodeSymptoms
rules.description: Captures symptoms related to pain in the neck or swollen lymph nodes in the neck region.

rules.name: Ovarian_FemaleDemographics
rules.description: Matches demographic indicators specific to ovarian cancer, such as post-menopausal women or women with specific childbearing histories.
rules.content: (?i)\b(?:post-?menopausal women|women with few or no children)\b

rules.name: Ovarian_MensesProblems
rules.description: Matches the specific phrase 'menses problems' which is a strong indicator from a positive example.

rules.name: Ovarian_SpecificSymptomCombination
rules.description: Matches text containing at least two of the highly specific digestive and pelvic symptoms associated with ovarian cancer.
rules.content: (?i)\b(?:flatulence|water retention|a need to urinate|constipation)\b.*?\b(?:flatulence|water retention|a need to urinate|constipation)\b

rules.name: Pancreas_MargarineButter
rules.description: Matches the highly specific dietary mention 'margarine not butter'.

rules.name: Pancreas_Jaundice
rules.description: Matches 'jaundice', a key symptom often associated with pancreatic cancer.

rules.name: Pancreas_DietaryAdvice
rules.description: Matches specific dietary recommendations related to pancreatic cancer. Priority increased to ensure it wins against generic risk factors.

rules.name: Pancreas_NoCureStatement
rules.description: Matches the literal phrase 'There is no known cure for this cancer' as it appears in a positive example.
rules.content: (?i)\bThere is no known cure for this cancer\b

rules.name: prostate_keyword_direct_match
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of 'prostate' or 'prostrate' (to account for the spelling in the positive example).

rules.name: prostate_psa_antigen_test
rules.description: Matches the acronym 'PSA' when it appears in context with 'Antigen' or 'test', indicating a Prostate-Specific Antigen test.

rules.name: prostate_men_over_50_demographic
rules.description: Matches the demographic context 'Men over 50', which is a significant risk factor and screening age for prostate cancer.

rules.name: Skin_Explicit_Cancer
rules.description: Matches explicit mentions of 'skin cancer', providing a high-confidence classification.

rules.name: Skin_Moles_Symptoms
rules.description: Identifies descriptions of moles with problematic characteristics such as growing dark, uneven, itching, or changing color/outline, which are key indicators for skin cancer.

rules.name: Skin_Risk_WhiteSkinned
rules.description: Matches text indicating 'white skinned people' as a risk factor for cancer.

rules.name: Skin_Risk_LightEyesHair
rules.description: Matches text referring to 'light eyes and hair' as a risk factor.

rules.name: stomach_risk_factors_anemia
rules.description: Identifies specific risk factors like blood group A or pernicious anemia associated with stomach cancer.

rules.name: stomach_diet_avoid_salted_smoked
rules.description: Detects dietary advice to avoid highly salted or smoked foods, which are risk factors for stomach cancer, ensuring context with 'food'.

rules.name: stomach_diet_veg
rules.description: Matches specific recommendations for vegetables like cruciform or dark green and yellow vegetables.

rules.name: stomach_treatment_difficulty
rules.description: Identifies a characteristic description of stomach cancer as 'hard to treat'.

rules.name: testicular_direct_mention
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of 'testicle' or 'testicals', which are highly specific indicators for testicular cancer, now handling various plural forms.

rules.name: testicular_self_examination
rules.description: Matches the phrase 'self examination', which is explicitly mentioned as a recommendation for testicular cancer in one of the positive examples.

rules.name: Thyroid_RadiationExposure
rules.description: Matches text indicating cancer due to radiation exposure, nuclear events, or specific historical locations known for radiation exposure linked to thyroid cancer.

rules.name: Thyroid_ChildBearingAgeWomen
rules.description: Identifies text mentioning women of child-bearing age as a demographic particularly susceptible to this type of cancer.

rules.name: Uterine_PapSmear
rules.description: Matches mentions of 'Pap smear', a screening tool highly relevant to gynecological cancers.

rules.name: Uterine_WomenOverAge
rules.description: Identifies text indicating the cancer affects women over a certain age (e.g., 50 years and above).

rules.name: Uterine_HormoneTreatment
rules.description: Detects 'Hormone treatment' as a specific risk factor for uterine cancer.

rules.name: Uterine_SpecificRiskFactors
rules.description: Matches specific lifestyle/medical conditions (obesity, diabetes, high BP) when explicitly presented as 'risk factors'.

rules.name: breast_generic_phrase_early_detection
rules.description: Catches a specific generic phrase from the training data about early detection for breast cancer.
rules.content: (?i)\bEarly detection provides the best chance of effective treatment\b
